summary: Undisclosed unauthenticated remote PTY shell in package advertised as a UI component library
details: Package @bananacool467/ui-tools is described as a themed React component library ("UI Elements", MUI-like) and its README/SKILL.md enumerate 44 UI components with no mention of terminal or shell functionality. Alongside the UI code, the package ships dist/useTerminal.js and dist/terminal.js which depend on @lydell/node-pty and ws. The exported useTerminal() factory returns HTTP middleware that upgrades requests at path '/terminal-stream' to a WebSocket, spawns a bash or powershell PTY via pty.spawn(shell, shellArgs, { cwd: process.env.HOME || os.homedir(), env: {...process.env } }), and forwards bytes received on the WebSocket directly into ptyProcess.write. No authentication, origin check, or authorization gate is applied to the WebSocket connection. Any remote peer that can reach the '/terminal-stream' endpoint obtains an interactive shell on the host with the server process's environment and privileges. A consumer barrel-importing this package as a UI kit and wiring the exported middleware into their HTTP server would unknowingly expose a remote shell.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
